name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – § 100 – Am 38
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 100. Reiterates its long-standing position that all EU-level spending should be brought within the purview of the budgetary authority, thereby ensuring democratic control, transparency and the protection of the Union’s financial interests; insists, in this regard, on the implementation of mandatory preventive mechanisms and screening measures for all participants in EU-funded projects, regardless of the financial value involved; underlines that such rigorous scrutiny must include systematic ex ante verification, anti-mafia certification and due diligence on ownership structures to prevent any infiltration by organised crime groups;
